item.title: A $33 billion nuclear bailout is coming to your electric bill
item.description: New Yorkers will pay $33 billion from 2029–2049 to keep four aging upstate nuclear plants operating, under a new PSC approval. Column by Karl Grossman

item.title: Riverhead’s Old Time Jam Band’s music is ‘upbeat, happy’ — and contagious
item.description: The Old Time Jam Band keeps Appalachian dance tunes alive with an upbeat, welcoming jam circle twice a month at Riverhead library.

item.title: Updated blizzard warning for Long Island: 15-20″ of snow, gusts up to 60 mph expected
item.description: A blizzard warning is in effect for Long Island and the New York City metro area from 1 p.m. Sunday through 6 p.m. Monday.

item.title: Winter storm emergency in effect in Riverhead as starting 9 p.m. Saturday; on-street parking banned
item.description: A winter storm emergency has been declared in Riverhead as of 9 p.m. Saturday, for a major storm expected to bring heavy snow and strong winds to the area Sunday and Monday.

item.title: Jessica Zablocky Altieri, 35
item.description: Jessica Zablocky Altieri died Feb. 18, 2026. She was 35 years old.

item.title: Police seek help locating 15-year-old reported missing from Riverhead
item.description: Riverhead Police are asking for the public’s help locating Nahomy Ireny Osorio Cruz, 15, who left her Riverhead residence late Feb. 20, 2026. Anyone with information is asked to call (631) 727-4500.

item.title: Snowfall projection rises again: 16-24″ now forecast across region: NWS
item.description: A winter storm the National Weather Service is now calling “potentially historic” is forecast to drop 16-24 inches of snow across the region, with moderate to locally major coastal flooding and wind gusts of up to 60 mph.

item.title: Duffy MX Motocross Track proposal scoped for environmental impact review
item.description: The environmental impact analysis for a proposed motocross track on River Road was scoped out by Riverhead Town during a hearing this week.

item.title: Winter storm closings and cancellations
item.description: Closings and cancellations due to the Feb. 22-23 blizzard.

item.title: Updated blizzard warning forecasts 18 to 23″ of snow; travel ban takes effect 9 p.m. Sunday
item.description: Travel is banned throughout Suffolk County as of 9 p.m. Sunday night, as the region braces for a major winter storm heading up the coast that's expected to drop up to 23 inches of snow on Long Island.
